answer: Standing decays sharply after 2 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The walnut decay curve is applied at each close, opal records the drop, and vine recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks thus finds them worthless when it returns to them. Repeating the trick 20 times costs 47 separate deposits and 43 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
